---
title: "Hierachical Aglomerative Clustering (HAC)"
---

# Importación de Librerias

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import altair as alt
# ---
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import dendrogram, linkage
```

# Carga del Dataset
## Cargando datos del CSV desde URL

```{python}
iris = load_iris()
X = pd.DataFrame(iris.data, columns=iris.feature_names)[['sepal length (cm)','sepal width (cm)']]
X
```

#Cargar el Dataset

```{python}
pipeline = Pipeline ([
    ('scaler',StandardScaler()),
    ('agglo',AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2))
])
```


# Fit


```{python}
labels =pipeline.fit_predict(X)
labels
```


# Visualizar los cluster



```{python}
# Escalar los datos manualmente antes de visualizarlos
X_scaled = pipeline.named_steps['scaler'].transform(X)
df_viz = pd.DataFrame(X_scaled, columns=['Feature1', 'Feature2'])
df_viz['cluster'] = labels.astype(int)

```

# Graficar
# Mostrar la gráfica de clusters

```{python}
alt.Chart(df_viz).mark_circle(size=60).encode(
    x='Feature1',
    y='Feature2',
    color='cluster:N',
    tooltip=['Feature1', 'Feature2', 'cluster']
).properties(
    width=400,
    height=300,
    title='Clusters HAC (Agglomerative)'
).interactive()
```

```{python}
esscater = alt.Chart(df_viz).mark_circle(size=20).encode(
    alt.X('Feature1'),
    alt.Y('Feature2'),
    alt.Color('cluster'),
    tooltip=['Feature1', 'Feature2','cluster']
).interactive()
esscater
```

# Linkage
```{python}
linkage(X_scaled,method='ward')
```
